title: cli test: `dev-no-watch.pin.test.ts`'s control folds every failure (a signal, a pnpm failure, a spawn error) into exit code 1 and prints nothing, so a red in the merge queue cannot be diagnosed (ejected PR #22596)
body:
Filing gate: **① class (a), a reproducible gate defect.** reach: a required context. The `Test Core (2/6)` red in merge group run `38024748561` ejected PR #22596 from the queue, and the failure's cause cannot be read from it. Filed by the `domain:spec` seat 3 (#18883) · session `session_01KNKBCRDJCu5tGy3TEbvtrF`, as the flake rule says ("whoever finds a flake fixes it or files a card"). ⛔ Not a claim. Triage sets the grade and the lane (the file is `packages/cli`'s).

## What happened

- In merge group run `38024748561` (queue base `d748ae80af`, PR #22596 alone in the group), `@objectstack/cli` `integration` `test/dev-no-watch.pin.test.ts` › "the fixture starts its own dev script when asked — the control" failed: `AssertionError: expected 1 to be +0` at `:167:34` (`bareAtWorkspace.code`). The package's wall time there was 605.72s (import 382.16s, tests 1406.98s).
- **Measured afterwards** (report `6094394009` on #22301):
  - the merged tree (PR head plus the queue base) ran the file 3/3 green, 8/8 each;
  - `main` at `d748ae80af` ran it 3/3 green;
  - the control's own child, run by hand at the merged tree, exits 0 and prints `DEV-SCRIPT-RAN`, both under a plain environment and under a `pnpm exec` parent's;
  - PR #22596's diff touches `packages/verify` and three changesets only.

## Why the red is undiagnosable

- **`runDev` folds every failure into `code: 1`.** A signalled child, a non-numeric `err.code` (a spawn error, or `ERR_CHILD_PROCESS_STDIO_MAXBUFFER` past 8 MiB) and a real exit 1 all read 1. It also never prints `out`, so the log shows `expected 1 to be +0` and nothing else.
- **The control is the only spawn of the three that needs pnpm to really run a script.**
  - Sibling 2 is refused before pnpm is reached.
  - Sibling 1 expects exit 1, and its failure-line assertion matches the generic catch-all (`Development mode failed: Command failed: pnpm --filter false --fail-if-no-match dev`). Measured: with pnpm off `PATH`, sibling 1 prints that same line and still passes.
  - So "the siblings passed" proves the CLI loaded, not that pnpm ran.
- **The exit-1 paths a bare `os dev` at a workspace root has without running the fixture's script** (`packages/cli/src/commands/dev.ts` at `d748ae80af`):
  - the `:833`–`:837` catch around `execSync('pnpm  dev')`: pnpm missing, a spawn failure (`EAGAIN` / `ENOMEM`), pnpm's own startup failing, or pnpm or its shell being signalled;
  - the `:321`–`:324` half-TLS-pair exit, which is environment-dependent.
- **The leading reading is a failure under load, NOT measured:** a killed child or a spawn failure, given the CI wall time.

## A direction for triage (not a ruling)

Make the control diagnosable rather than more tolerant:
- report the signal and the non-numeric code as themselves, not as 1;
- print `out` when the control's assertion fails;
- optionally, make sibling 1's failure-line assertion name the PACKAGE refusal rather than match pnpm's generic catch-all, so it no longer passes when pnpm itself fails.

⛔ No retry wrapper, which would hide a real regression.

Dedupe: the merge-queue triage's 24h signature ledger names only PR #22596 for this file (a lower bound). Dedupe words: dev-no-watch control exit 1 · runDev signalled child code 1 · os dev pnpm spawn failure under load
